premises.text: Mobile fragmentation forces costly device fleets and testers; cloud log-based testing without the device in hand is slow and painful
premises.evidence_span: mobile fragmentation is now really ruining for mobile app developers

premises.text: NativeTap streams real remote physical devices for lifelike multi-touch interaction and USB-like debugging as if the device were on the desk
premises.evidence_span: access and interact with any real mobile device just with one tap

premises.text: Patent-pending low-latency I/O transfer, dense custom servers, demand-driven inventory/queuing, and cooling racks enable scalable device farms
premises.evidence_span: patent pending input-output transfer technology that allows lifelike interaction with nearly zero latency

premises.text: Planned capabilities include replicating touch events across cloud devices and connecting IoT peripherals to remote device fleets
premises.evidence_span: you can test on one device and all of those touch events will be replicated on all of the devices in the cloud

value.text: Saving money and time to build better apps with broader device reach
value.evidence_span: You save money. You can access any device anytime you want for a fraction of cost

causal_links.evidence_span: spending one third of your total development budget just on testing
interact with them as if they were on your desk
Your team works much more efficiently
